entries.title: Narrator: "I had called a council meeting in F..."
entries.dialogueText: I had called a council meeting in Fort Ales to discuss our strategy in the Pales gas dispute.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The city was named after its most f..."
entries.dialogueText: The city was named after its most famous building, a Valgish fortress that now served as the government headquarters for the Pales Administrative District.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus escorted me down the hallway..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus escorted me down the hallway to a nondescript conference room, where Laurento, Lucita, Elena and Hugo were already waiting.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took a seat across from Lucita."
entries.dialogueText: I took a seat across from Lucita.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I looked around the room."
entries.dialogueText: I looked around the room.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Good morning, Your Majesty. Should..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good morning, Your Majesty. Should we fill you in on the situation so far?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, please.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, please."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've read the reports. I know abou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've read the reports. I know about the Palesian drillship."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Duke Reinhart is now under the imp..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duke Reinhart is now under the impression that the entire gas field belongs to Pales. He has ordered that exploratory drilling begin immediately."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "We made eye contact for a brief mom..."
entries.dialogueText: We made eye contact for a brief moment.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I'll take it from here. As you kno..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll take it from here. As you know, our joint team of researchers recently completed their assessment of the gas field between Pales and Rizia -- tentatively nicknamed Aureus."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""However, a few days after our team..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, a few days after our team's return to port, we received the news that the Palesians had made a different decision."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The Rizian surveyors determined th..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Rizian surveyors determined that the field lay in both Rizian and Palesian territory."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Then where should we start, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then where should we start, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well... why is this a dispute? I t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well... why is this a dispute? I thought our maritime borders were clear."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do we now know how much gas the fi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do we now know how much gas the field contains?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's enough information. I'm rea..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's enough information. I'm ready to discuss our response."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""We still don't have exact numbers...."
entries.dialogueText: "We still don't have exact numbers. But the surveyors have confirmed that it's a lot."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Quite possibly more than the curre..."
entries.dialogueText: "Quite possibly more than the current natural gas reserves of Rizia and Pales combined."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""In other words, whichever country..."
entries.dialogueText: "In other words, whichever country controls the Aureus field will become Merkopa's next energy superpower."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""They've been shifting for the past..."
entries.dialogueText: "They've been shifting for the past century."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The late Empire of Valgos used to..."
entries.dialogueText: "The late Empire of Valgos used to control the waters between Pales and Caleqabiz. But the area came into question when the island joined Rizia in 1855."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Ah, yes. ANDOR.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ah, yes. ANDOR."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""And in case of overlap, no one cou..."
entries.dialogueText: "And in case of overlap, no one country may exploit those resources without the other's agreement."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""A nation has the sovereign right t..."
entries.dialogueText: "A nation has the sovereign right to any undersea gas and oil wells located within 200 kilometers of its coast."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So it's clear. Pales is breaking t..."
entries.dialogueText: "So it's clear. Pales is breaking the law by claiming sole ownership."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The borders that Rizia recognizes..."
entries.dialogueText: "The borders that Rizia recognizes today are the ones defined by the 1942 AN Directive on Offshore Resources. According to those, the field should be split almost exactly evenly between our two nations."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Technically, no. Reinhart's predec..."
entries.dialogueText: "Technically, no. Reinhart's predecessor signed ANDOR, but the Duke has yet to ratify it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are both Pales and Rizia signatori..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are both Pales and Rizia signatories of this directive?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What happens if a country violates..."
entries.dialogueText: "What happens if a country violates that directive?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Rizia has both signed and ratified..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia has both signed and ratified ANDOR. Reinhart's predecessor signed the directive, but the Duke has yet to ratify it."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""They'd be subject to prosecution i..."
entries.dialogueText: "They'd be subject to prosecution in an international court. And any military action against them would be fully justified."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Technically, Pales wouldn't be vio..."
entries.dialogueText: "Technically, Pales wouldn't be violating ANDOR by drilling without Rizia's consent. Reinhart's predecessor signed the directive, but the Duke has yet to ratify it."
